title: Parallel sentences: Aruban Papiamento translations of the prompts

fields.name: prompt_id
fields.description: The prompt this translates. It must be in prompts.tsv in the same folder, so held-out prompts and their translations stay together.

fields.name: pap
fields.description: The sentence in Aruban Papiamento, written by a person. A prompt can have several rows: there is often more than one good translation.

fields.name: translated_by
fields.description: Handle of the person who wrote the sentence (_meta/contributors.tsv). Never machine: the tool shows no machine draft.

fields.name: checked_by
fields.description: Handles of the other teachers who rated the sentence good, separated by '; '

fields.name: fix_of
fields.description: Id of the row this one corrects, when a rater proposed a fix

fields.name: flags_kept
fields.description: Checker findings the writer kept on purpose: rule ids from rules/rules.jsonl, barbarismo ids (bar-) or Curacao-Aruba ids (var-), separated by '; '

fields.name: batch
fields.description: The batch the row arrived in: prompts-1, prompts-2 ... for prompts; contrib-YYYY-MM-DD for a contribution-tool sync. With translated_by or author it is the row's provenance.

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.description: GitHub usernames of the review-board members who confirmed the row, separated by '; '. Required when status is reviewed.

$comment: For corpus/parallel/pairs.tsv and eval/parallel/pairs.tsv. pap gets the Aruban spelling checks. No source/page: a contributed sentence has no printed page; translated_by and batch are its provenance (decided by the maintainer on 2026-10-18). CC0 1.0 (LICENSE-DATA). See _meta/conventions.md, Parallel sentences.
